data.name: State of Command
data.detailed_description:
STATE OF COMMAND

State of Command is a modern grand strategy game where you lead a nation as its head of state, balancing military command, economic management, and diplomacy in a dynamic geopolitical sandbox.

Direct brigade-level military forces across a living world map while guiding your nation’s political and strategic direction. Organize your armed forces, plan large-scale offensives, respond to international crises, and shape the balance of power through decisive leadership.

Rather than following scripted paths, the world reacts to the conditions you create. Political movements rise and fall, conflicts escalate or resolve, and the global landscape evolves based on the decisions made by you and other nations.

Build and manage your military, guide your country's development, and navigate an unpredictable international environment where every campaign can unfold differently.

Key Features

  • Command NATO accurate battle groups across land, air, and sea

  • Modding tools that open the doors to many more worlds of gameplay

  • Straightforward and easy to pick up on whilst maintaining depth and opportunity for growth.

  • Manage your nation's political direction, diplomacy, and economic priorities

  • A systems-driven geopolitical sandbox where events emerge from player actions

  • Dynamic conflicts and shifting global tensions

  • Military organization designed to be deep while remaining accessible

  • Player-driven alternate history and emergent outcomes

State of Command focuses on giving players meaningful control over how their nation develops, allowing strategy, leadership, and decision-making to shape the course of world events.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 4.3 compatible GPU (NVIDIA GTX 650 / AMD HD 7750 or equivalent)
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 / SteamOS
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 4.3 compatible GPU
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
